title: Electoral Legislation Amendment (Fair and Transparent Elections) Bill 2024
short_title: Electoral Legislation Amendment (Fair and Transparent Elections) Bill 2024

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would amend the Commonwealth Electoral Act 1918 and related legislation to tighten donation disclosure, restrict some donations and government advertising, and let independent candidates register campaign entities.
It would lower the donation disclosure threshold from $16,300 to a fixed $1,000 and require recipients to disclose gifts within 7 days of the threshold being exceeded.

It would also bar donations from tobacco, fossil fuel, gambling and liquor businesses, substantial Commonwealth contractors and bidders, defining substantial contractors as those paid over $200,000 by the Commonwealth in the last 24 months.
changes: Contributions by a person and associated entities over an election cycle would be capped at 2 per cent of public funding at the previous election.
Printing, publishing or distributing electoral or referendum matter with a materially misleading or deceptive statement of fact would be unlawful.
The definition of a gift would widen to cover fundraising dinners, paid business forums and membership fees benefiting a party or candidate.
An independent campaign entity, registered with nomination by at least 100 electors, would be treated like a registered political party for electoral roll access and disclosure deadlines.
Government advertising would be prohibited from 2 years after a general election until the next election unless the Independent Communications Committee determines it exempt.
Only the Australian Electoral Commission (AEC) postal vote application form could be used, and parties or candidates could not lodge it with the AEC for a voter.
summary.affected: Political parties, candidates, donors, independent candidates, tobacco, fossil fuel, gambling and liquor businesses, and substantial Commonwealth contractors and bidders are affected.
